# TheCollinsGaming

> TheCollinsGaming is a League of Legends content creator based on the Oceania (OCE) server, specializing in Garen top lane. Known for consistent Garen OCE ranked climbs and duo queue content, TheCollinsGaming streams live on Kick and Twitch, with daily short-form clips and full match VODs on YouTube.

## Identity

- Name: TheCollinsGaming
- Game: League of Legends
- Champion: Garen (top lane)
- Server: Oceania (OCE)
- Handle: @thecollinsgaming / @thecollinsgaming8 (Instagram, TikTok)

## FAQ

### Who is TheCollinsGaming?
TheCollinsGaming is a League of Legends content creator specializing in Garen on the Oceania (OCE) server.

### What server does TheCollinsGaming play on?
TheCollinsGaming plays on the Oceania (OCE) server.

### What champion does TheCollinsGaming main?
TheCollinsGaming mains Garen in the top lane.

### Where does TheCollinsGaming stream?
TheCollinsGaming streams live on Kick (primary) and Twitch (secondary).

### Where can I watch full matches?
Full match VODs are on the TheCollinsGaming YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@thecollinsgaming

### What rank is TheCollinsGaming?
TheCollinsGaming currently plays at Platinum-Emerald rank on the Oceania (OCE) server, with content documenting the ranked climb.

### Does TheCollinsGaming play champions other than Garen?
While Garen is the primary main, TheCollinsGaming also plays other champions on an alt account, including casual and duo queue sessions with friends.

### What is Garen OCE?
"Garen OCE" refers to TheCollinsGaming's identity as a dedicated Garen one-trick content creator on the Oceania (OCE) League of Legends server, covering ranked climbs, matchups, and live gameplay.

### Where can I watch full League of Legends OCE ranked climbs?
Full ranked climb VODs are uploaded to the TheCollinsGaming YouTube channel, with live ranked play streamed on Kick and Twitch.

### What kind of content does TheCollinsGaming post?
Three formats: short clips (highlights and standout plays), medium-length YouTube VODs (full match breakdowns), and live streams on Kick and Twitch covering both solo ranked climbs and duo queue sessions.

### Where is TheCollinsGaming's community?
The TheCollinsGaming Discord server is the main community hub, linked from the channel and this page.
